cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Approved Explanation
cards.instruction: Protect someone or the group by maintaining a simplified account that everyone can safely repeat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Grandad's embarrassed about the gazebo. Let's tell everyone the party moved indoors because the garden's unavailable.

mechanism: Copy a confident party explanation in the wrong context, then protect Grandad through a shared indoor-party account.
confusable: Distinguish a knowing cover story from misunderstanding: B2 corrects which entertainment B described, and A3 pretends that was understood.
comparison: Family face-saving via a birthday speech differs from colleague coordination at the gate.
seedUse: Uses the canonical gazebo/fire/speech Drive seed with a new misapplied magician reassurance for S04; canonical dependencies only.
